messages:
Erica: kicking off a config-only deploy for production — tinybatch throttles + routing weight tweak. no model code changes, just params. canary plan: 5% for 10m -> hold -> 50% ramp in 30m. change_id=cfg-2026-031. pin model-version=redwood-v2-engine-202602. rolling now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: cfg-2026-031 (config-only). namespace=production. Canary=5% for 10m. /deploy info: https://internal/deploys/cfg-2026-031
Mike: ack. will watch latency dashboards (p50/p95/p99) and kvcache hitrate.
Sam: quick question — what are rollback thresholds? p99 or error-rate? :eyes:
Erica: rollback if p99 > 180ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR error-rate increases by >0.5 percentage points vs baseline. also tenant floor set: min_qps=50. keep canary locked if either triggers.
Anya: copying logs — small bump in tail latency right after canary apply. p99 +~20ms for long-seq tenants.
Sam: that's within the threshold for now. keep monitoring for 2 more mins.
Mike: kvcache hitrate dipped ~6% on memtier-2. any TTL changes? I didn't expect cache churn from batching.
Erica: no TTL changes. suspected cause: batch_window_ms increased from 8 -> 12 for canary and max_tokens_per_batch lowered 200 -> 120. those tweak scheduling; might affect cache locality. if hitrate falls >8% we'll revert batch_window.
deploy-bot: Config applied to canary: {
  batch_window_ms: 12,
  max_tokens_per_batch: 120,
  route_weight: {blue: 0.05}
}
deploy-bot: Scheduled ramp -> 50% in 30m (manual pause allowed).
deploy-bot: ALERT: error-rate +0.8pp detected at 11:32 UTC. Pausing ramp and holding canary at 5%.
Erica: pausing ramp. @Sam @Mike please pull traces and sampling for 500s. I'll start a quick impact analysis.
Sam: I'm seeing a spike in 500s originating from svc-routing: stack shows "route-resolver" timing out on backend lookups. suspect route overflow when batch sizes changed.
Mike: I can apply a quick hotfix config to reduce concurrency: max_inflight_per_tenant 20 -> 10 for the canary. that should limit pressure on route-resolver.
Anya: do we need a PR? or can we patch the runtime config directly for canary?
Erica: go ahead with a direct canary patch (no full rollout). we'll keep frozen until we confirm stability. log the change_id as cfg-2026-031a.
deploy-bot: PATCH applied to canary: max_inflight_per_tenant=10. Change recorded: cfg-2026-031a. Observability: allow 5m stabilization.
Sam: error-rate dropping back to baseline now. p99 trending down. kvcache hitrate also recovering.
Mike: good. I added a line to the release notes: "config: temporary inflight cap for canary; adjusted batch window and max_tokens_per_batch; pinned route weight for initial canary" — will push to docs.
Erica: thanks. we'll stop the ramp for today and schedule a narrower gradual rollout in tomorrow's change window (longer observation windows and smaller batch_window increases).
Anya: noted — I'll open a follow-up ticket with perf test to simulate long sequences and measure kvcache behaviour when batch_window varies.
Erica: closing thread for now. nice quick ops everyone :rocket:
